The '''Shimia system''' was a distant [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]], within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Terrortories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shimia/Legends|Shimia]].
